text: In Poway, we enjoy the best roads, finest first responders, lowest taxes, healthy reserves, outstanding parks and amenities. We’re the envy of San Diego County.

But good government is no accident. I have served as your Councilmember since 2025, providing responsible stewardship of all that makes Poway unique. Your vote for me will help Poway remain a well-managed, fiscally sound city.

As an engineer with a law degree, and three years serving on Poway’s Budget Review Committee, I bring a high level of insight and attention to detail on City matters, from budgets and contracts to policies and development projects.
My commitment to you includes advocating for improvements on Highway 67 – the site of many traffic fatalities – as a board member of the San Diego Association of Governments.

You’ll also find me throughout the community at city-sponsored events, as an active member of Poway Kiwanis and Poway Chamber of Commerce, and a proud supporter of performances at the Poway Center for the Performing Arts.

Because I represent our neighborhood on council, I want to hear from you. Contact me at 858-746-0000. Together, we can ensure that Poway remains the best place to live, work, and play. As your councilmember and neighbor, I would be honored to continue serving you.
Proudly endorsed by: Poway Firefighters Association and Deputy Sheriffs’ Association.
